title: Add a software block to the physical architecture and link it
task: Create a new software block named 'ValidationProbeBlock' in the physical architecture package of this model, then report the id the tool assigned to it.
rationale: One mutating task so the suite can measure write behaviour, and it is pointed at a scratch copy on purpose. The pristine SAF_FFDS.mdzip is a human-maintained sample from another repository; a validation run that dirties it would destroy someone else's work to produce a number.
preconditions: SAF_FFDS.scratch.mdzip loaded -- a disposable COPY of SAF_FFDS.mdzip
NEVER run this task against the pristine SAF_FFDS.mdzip: it is a shared sample model from the SAF profile repo, not a scratch file

oracle.name: ValidationProbeBlock
oracle.note: created by the run; absence means the create did not happen

oracle.name: ValidationProbeBlock
oracle.note: more than one means a retry created a duplicate

outcomes: One ValidationProbeBlock exists with the id the tool returned
needsCalibration: confirm the scratch copy exists and is loaded; `bin/vmodel resolve ffds-scratch`
the create may land in a different package than intended -- check the parentId in the run output before trusting the count clauses
